description: One Moon is one week. The Moon shifts the whole city's odds under every Omen. Tilt values run from -2 to +2 per errand.

moons.name: Plague Moon
moons.reading: Chalk on the doors. The Sisters do not sleep.

moons.name: Hunter's Moon
moons.reading: Wide hats in every doorway. Nobody drinks. Nobody trades.
moons.notes: Witch Hunters patrol. Spy and Pray risky, Trade quiet.

moons.name: Green Moon
moons.reading: The comet flares. The rubble hums.

moons.name: Festival of Hanging
moons.reading: The gibbets are full and so are the taverns.
moons.notes: Carouse and the Pit boosted. Renown doubled.

moons.name: Silent Moon
moons.reading: No Omens. No bells. Whoever is listening has stopped.
moons.notes: The Omen's tilt does not apply. Whispers cheap. A rest week.

moons.name: Market Moon
moons.reading: Barges on the Stir. Every fence has two prices and both are good.

moons.name: Ash Moon
moons.reading: The wind is from the west. The streets rewrite themselves.
moons.notes: Map ink flows. Sifting finds streets, not stones.

moons.name: Debtor's Moon
moons.reading: Old Henrik is calling in what he is owed. So is everyone else.
